rule_implemented_v2p8_1.v: abort OVER_THRUST when 3 consecutive fresh FC_THRUST frames carry the valid flag and a value > 650 N while the ECU is in RUN in FLIGHT mode; fresh = received within 50 ms of the previous one (+1 us slack); the count restarts on a frame <= threshold, a frame with the flag clear, a gap > 50 ms or leaving RUN; the abort is taken on the tick that receives the 3rd frame and drops the MV latch drive on that tick

item4_valid_flag.v: FC sets b0 only while airborne, engine lit (ECU RUN) and drogue released; the ECU additionally requires RUN, the FLIGHT strap, freshness <= 50 ms and 3 consecutive frames; a stale stream or b0 = 0 never aborts: it clears the count, raises the log flag (seq2_flags b4 clear, fc_thr_dN 0xFFFF) and TLM fault bit only
